column1: # The pristine transcription: the Haskell code of the Haskell 98 Report's Prelude and libraries, as printed in the
# online Revised Report of December 2002 (https://www.haskell.org/onlinereport/, fetched on 2026-11-01; each page
# byte-identical to the official tarball haskell98-report-html.tar.gz). Each file is the text of the page's code

# blocks for one module, taken mechanically from the HTML:
ends a line, entities are decoded, a non-breaking
# space is a space, the page's own tabs are kept, nothing else is changed. synopsis/ holds the interface a chapter
# prints before its code, where it prints one. Never edit these files: they are what overlay.tsv is held to.
# Columns: file, module, section, page, page_sha256 (the HTML page), lines, sha256 (the file).
